system.description:
Repair (OPDQ): roll your Smarts Pool. Repair 1 wound on a piece of armour or a vehicle, plus 1 more for each Smarts symbol rolled. Limit 3 uses.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.159
system.summary: Repair (OPDQ): roll your Smarts Pool. Repair 1 wound on a piece of armour or a vehicle, plus 1 more for each Smarts symbol rolled. Limit 3 uses.

automation.label: Repair
automation.onSuccess: Repair 1 wound on one piece of armour or a vehicle, plus 1 per Smarts symbol rolled.
automation.onFail: No Smarts symbols: repair 1 wound only.

automation.note: Quantity tracks the 3 total uses. After the roll, restore 1 + (Smarts symbols) Health Points to the chosen armour's slots or the vehicle by hand. A roll with no Smarts symbols shows Failure but still repairs 1.
